newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Aug 8-Sept 7 Fipe inflation at 0.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Aug 8-Sept 7 Fipe inflation at 0.25 pct.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) was 0.25 percent in the August 8-September 7 period, down from 0.34 percent in the previous four-week period, a Fipe official said.
Juarez Rizzieri also gave the following breakdown of the Fipe weighted index for the period.
- Food -0.66 pct fall in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures at weekly intervals.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
